title: meter
description: A value within a range or against a target: one bar, a bar per item, nested rings, or an arc with zones.

style.description: bar: one bar per item (one item renders as a hero). ring: 1–3 nested rings with a legend. arc: one item on an open arc with its zones.

label.description: What is measured: Spent in October, Steps, Protein, /data. Read by VoiceOver even when the title says it.

value.description: The current value. null when it couldn’t be read: an empty dashed track, — for the number, and `state: unverified`. Never 0 for unknown.

target.description: The goal or limit: shown as “of $2,000” or “/ 10,000”, and as a tick on the bar when it sits inside the scale.

max.description: End of the scale, in the value’s units. Defaults to `target.value`. Set it when the target sits inside the scale (a disk at 100% with a warning zone from 90%).

from.description: Where the zone starts, in the value’s units (included).

to.description: Where it ends (not included). Omit for “and above”.

state.description: What being in the zone means. Bars and rings stay ink in ok and info zones; only warning and critical colour the fill. An arc tints every zone.

label.description: The zone’s name in words, under an arc and read by VoiceOver: Low, Fair, Good, Nearly full, Over budget.

items.description: A range of the scale that means a state.

zones.description: Zones for this item only; they replace the widget’s `zones`.

remaining.description: Under a single bar, show what’s left, computed by the client from target − value: “$160 left”, or “$40 over” past the target.

note.description: One line: trailing under a single bar, or under the item’s legend entry: “12 days to go”, “Watch not synced since 14:00”.

mono.description: Draw the label monospaced: paths, hosts, branch names.

items.description: One measured value. It needs a scale: `max`, `target`, or both.
The values, in reading order. Empty only with the envelope’s `empty_text`.

from.description: Where the zone starts, in the value’s units (included).

to.description: Where it ends (not included). Omit for “and above”.

state.description: What being in the zone means. Bars and rings stay ink in ok and info zones; only warning and critical colour the fill. An arc tints every zone.

label.description: The zone’s name in words, under an arc and read by VoiceOver: Low, Fair, Good, Nearly full, Over budget.

items.description: A range of the scale that means a state.

zones.description: Zones shared by every item that has none of its own. In the value’s units.

headline.description: The conclusion in words, beside an arc (or under the bar or rings): “Ready for intervals”.

note.description: One or two sentences under the headline: what it is based on. “Slept 7 h 12, HRV above your usual, resting HR normal.”
